trust.headline: A considered approach|to buying in Lombok.
trust.lead: Lombok is more than a destination. For us, understanding the land, the people and the process is part of understanding the opportunity.
trust.buyingLead: Start with the right questions. These pathways introduce essentials to consider — not legal advice.
trust.pageLead: Buying land or property in Lombok involves context: ownership structures, due diligence, planning and local relationships. Green Hill helps clients navigate those questions with on-the-ground knowledge.
trust.disclaimer: This overview is educational. It is not legal, tax or investment advice. Specific requirements should be discussed with qualified professionals.

south.title: South Lombok
south.body: The character of the landscape — coast, hills and valleys — shapes how we look at opportunities.

access.title: Access
access.body: Location and how a place is reached matter when evaluating long-term potential.

lifestyle.title: Lifestyle
lifestyle.body: Land, landscape and community sit behind how people want to live and hold property here.

perspective.title: Long-term perspective
perspective.body: We weigh context and quality over volume — fewer opportunities, considered carefully.

ownership.title: Ownership & tenure
ownership.body: Understand the structures and questions to consider when buying in Lombok.
ownership.detail: Foreign buyers often encounter different ownership and company structures. The right questions depend on your goals, timeline and how you intend to hold the property. Green Hill can help you frame those questions before you proceed.

dueDiligence.title: Due diligence
dueDiligence.body: What should be understood before proceeding with an opportunity.
dueDiligence.detail: Due diligence covers the practical checks that sit behind a considered purchase — title, parties, boundaries and the story of the land. It is about clarity, not speed.

zoning.title: Zoning & planning
zoning.body: Why land use, planning and permitted development matter.
zoning.detail: What can be built — and how — depends on planning context. Understanding zoning and permitted use early helps avoid assumptions about development potential.

process.title: The buying process
process.body: A clearer view of the steps from initial enquiry to completion.
process.detail: From first conversation to notaries, local relationships and, where relevant, architects and builders — the process is clearer when each step is understood in sequence. Green Hill guides clients through discovery, evaluation and next steps.

final.headline: Let's talk about|what you're looking for.

final.contactPending: A direct contact channel will be confirmed shortly. For now, explore opportunities or return to this page once speaking with Reece is live.

founder.headline: I came to Lombok|looking for opportunities|for myself.
founder.story1: I originally came to Lombok looking for opportunities for myself, moving from the UK with my partner and daughter.
founder.story2: After buying land in Are Guling and going through the process personally, from finding land and ownership structures to notaries, due diligence, zoning, architects and builders, I began building relationships with local landowners, developers and professionals across South Lombok.
founder.story3: Those relationships started opening doors to opportunities that aren't always publicly marketed. Green Hill grew naturally from there.
founder.story4: Today, I personally visit and select the opportunities we represent, from individual building plots and villas to larger land and development opportunities.
founder.quote: I'm not interested in having the most listings.|I'm interested in finding the right ones.
founder.name: Reece Green
